linux.synopsis: Whispered aptitude test: flash reading of math, chemistry/physics and pharmacy terms and equations
linux.description: Omega-Whispered is an offline aptitude test app: flash (shundoku) presentation of technical terms, symbols and scrambled equations, equation-meaning analysis, PDF symbol and chemical-formula extraction, and a field-aptitude profile. Question sets cover mathematics, chemistry/physics (organic compounds, semiconductors, superconductivity) and pharmaceutical sciences (pharmacokinetics, pharmacodynamics, formulation, clinical pharmacy). Unofficial fan homage; for learning and entertainment only. The pharmacy questions are textbook study material and must not be used for diagnosis, prescribing or medication decisions.
